finalists.label: COVID-19-associated encephalitis
finalists.why: It has strong for evidence including SARS-CoV-2 RNA detection and multifocal discrete and confluent hypodensities in the brain.

finalists.label: Cerebrovascular disease
finalists.why: It has for evidence including progressive weakness and complete hemiplegia with no against evidence.

finalists.label: Acute Hemorrhagic Leukoencephalitis
finalists.why: It has strong for evidence including upper motor neuron type right-sided seventh cranial-nerve palsy and multifocal discrete and confluent hypodensities in the brain with no against evidence.

frontier_selector.why: The detection of SARS-CoV-2 RNA and the presence of multifocal discrete and confluent hypodensities in the brain decided the final comparison in favor of COVID-19-associated encephalitis.
